data.headline: Fractus files patent infringement complaint against ResMed in the Southern District of California
data.summary: Fractus, a pioneer in geometry-based antenna technology and IP licensing, today announced that it has filed a patent infringement complaint (3:25-cv-02680-LL-JLB) against ResMed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of California. The complaint alleges that ResMed's sleep apnea devices and related connected therapy solutions infringe multiple Fractus patents covering miniaturized, high-performance multi-band antenna innovations.
